subject: PlayVerse — monthly step-up commit & per-token discount proposal
messages:
From: Santiago Rios <santiago.rios@playverse.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@playverse.ai>; contracts@playverse.ai
Date: 2026-10-25T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing & ramp question for launch (PlayVerse)

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our product team is excited to move forward but we need to lock down economics for a six-month launch ramp. A few specifics we discussed internally:

- We expect a soft launch in January (beta) with an aggressive marketing push in March/April. Monthly token consumption will be lumpy: low in months 1–2, then step up significantly when campaigns hit.
- We want a usage-based model (per-token) with committed monthly minimums that step up across months rather than a single large prepay.
- Primary ask: can Redwood offer a step-up commit schedule with graduated per-token discounts? Also need to understand how overage pricing will work if we miss a commit month during beta.

Can you share a concrete proposal (monthly commit table + per-token price at each tier) and any contract language that protects us for seasonality? CC'd contracts.

Best,
Santiago
Head of Platform, PlayVerse
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Santiago Rios <santiago.rios@playverse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, contracts@playverse.ai
Date: 2026-10-26T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & ramp question for launch (PlayVerse)

Santiago —

Appreciate the clarity on seasonality. Attached is a preliminary proposal tailored to a six-month ramp with step-up commits and per-token discounts. High level:

- Month 1 (beta): commit $25k (baseline per-token $0.0006)
- Month 2: commit $50k (per-token $0.00055)
- Month 3: commit $120k (per-token $0.00048)
- Month 4: commit $200k (per-token $0.00042)
- Months 5–6: stable commit $250k/mo (per-token $0.00038)

Overages: if tokens exceed the monthly commit we bill actual usage at the committed-tier per-token rate for that month (no retroactive true-up to higher tiers) and apply a 10% premium if usage exceeds 150% of the committed month to discourage unexpected spikes.

Seasonality protection: we can include a two-month ‘grace’ within the six-month ramp where PlayVerse can reallocate up to 20% of a future commit to a prior month once during the ramp without penalty (documented in SLA addendum). After ramp, refunds/credits are by exception and require executive approval.

I’ve put the proposed SLA and more granular per-token math in the attached PV_Master_SLA_v3.pdf and the usage-projection-playverse.xlsx. Marissa and Rishi — please advise if we should tighten the overage premium or offer any additional volume break for committed annualization.

Next steps: if this looks directionally right, I can circulate a DocuSign-ready contract with the ramp table embedded and request legal signoff.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-26T11:48:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: PlayVerse pricing draft

Sofia — quick thoughts:

- The per-token ladder looks reasonable vs. our hosted baseline (we typically start enterprise at $0.00065 baseline when uncommitted).
- Recommend we soften the 10% overage premium to 5% for the first ramp two months to reduce friction — PlayVerse is early-stage but will need runway for campaign spikes. We can revert to 10% afterward.
- Add an explicit clause that allows swapping to a quantized (lower-cost) model variant for non-critical inference to control spend (e.g., q4_8bit fallback). Helps them hit economics without losing availability.

Markus — finance signoff needed on the temporary 5% overage. If approved, I'll let Sofia send updated terms and a DocuSign link.

- Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-27T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: PlayVerse pricing draft

Marissa —

Finance OK to pilot a reduced overage premium (5%) for the first two ramp months, contingent on:
1) PlayVerse signs the six-month ramp table and commits to the step-up schedule in the contract;
2) Redwood reserves right to revert to standard tiers if sustained usage > 200% of monthly commit for any two consecutive months.

Also agree with the model-fallback clause, but legal should ensure the SLA clearly states which endpoints/models are eligible and how quality/regression monitoring will be handled.

Markus Klein
Director, Revenue Finance

Date: 2026-11-02T09:06:00-08:00
Subject: Finalized step-up commit proposal & next steps (DocuSign)

Santiago —

Thanks for the patience. Per internal review we updated terms slightly and prepared a DocuSign packet:

- Ramp table (six months) — attached and embedded in DocuSign.
  Month 1: $25,000 (@ $0.0006/token)
  Month 2: $50,000 (@ $0.00055/token) — 5% overage premium allowed for months 1–2
  Month 3: $120,000 (@ $0.00048/token)
  Month 4: $200,000 (@ $0.00042/token)
  Month 5: $250,000 (@ $0.00038/token)
  Month 6: $250,000 (@ $0.00038/token)

- Overage mechanics: usage billed at the month-specific committed-tier per-token rate. If usage > 150% in a month, a 5% premium applies for months 1–2, 10% thereafter unless finance approves otherwise.

- Seasonality protection: one-time reallocation of up to 20% of a future month within the six-month ramp (documented in SLA).

- Fallback model clause: Redwood may route non-critical requests to a quantized model variant listed in the SLA; detailed regression thresholds are in the SLA addendum.

I’ve attached PV_Master_SLA_v3.pdf and the usage projection; DocuSign link is here if you’re ready: https://app.docusign.com/PlayVerse/PV-2026-1123. Please loop your contracts team if they need any wording updates — we can turn around a negotiated clause quickly.

If you sign, we’ll schedule a kickoff with Solutions + Infra to set QoS and KV cache priming for the launch ramp.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
